lines: Investigating a haunted castleーthat sounds like a pretty fun mission!
I had brought Hebiko and Shikanosuke with me to investigate again.
Even though it was close to the school, I was still worried about the Gonza incident the other day. We made a plan in advance and headed out fully prepared.
Hey, we didn't need to make a point of going at night, did we?
What? It's only when you go at night that you get into the right mood♪
Blech... I-I need to go to the bathroom...
Hey now, are you already freaking out? It's just a little test of courage.
It's going to be fine. The school is close by and if something happens, the four of us can handle it.
Aieee!! There's only three of us!! Stop that right noooow!!
No, no, there's really four of us. Right, sensei?
As I spoke, Shikanosuke's shadow swayed like a big blob.
Going so far as to use your Ninja Art to follow us... You must really like ghost stories...
Nyahaha♪ Please keep this a secret from onee-chan... from the headmistress!
Still, Sakura-sensei being here felt reassuring somehow. We headed towards the mountain, the road illuminated by the setting sun.
And by the time we reached the mountain path, it was completely dark.
The mountain path was narrow. I was walking up front since I knew the way.
When I turned around upon hearing a voice from behind, I saw Hebiko adjusting a radio.
Not bad, right? Hebiko borrowed it from Shikanosuke-chan.
Why did you bring a radio?
To listen to the weather forecast.
You can just check it with your smartphone.
How naive~ Smartphones are out of range on a mountain like this.
In the end, old things like this are the most reliable. Hebiko's granny-chan also always said that!
As she spoke, Hebiko desperately tried to find a frequency.
At that moment, something cold and wet hit my eyelid.
Didn't even need the weather forecast for that.
I feel like I'm finally in the right mood♪ ...But this rain might be pretty unpleasant?
You're right. It's definitely unpleasant... even though Hebiko likes rain.
The rain fell like a fine mist and enveloped our bodies completely.
Ahh, that's right, Hebiko-chan is a Beastified Taimanin who can turn into an octopus. Guess you don't mind water. What a unique and funny Ninja Art!
Hmmm, but Hebiko used to cry thinking it would be better to have a cool Ninja Art like yours, Sakura-sensei.
Hebiko kind of likes it now, though.
There's one Ninja Art for each Taimanin. This is the one thing we cannot choose.
(One Ninja Art for each Taimanin... huh.)
I still dreamt about it sometimes. About how one day, my right eye would suddenly open and my Evil Eye would awaken. And that skill would be something unprecedented...
(It's hard to accept. How can my Evil Eye awaken when I can't even open my right eye in the first place...)
Oops, right... Ahh, sorry, Fuma-kun, I was being inconsiderate...
The two of them looked embarrassed, maybe because they were uncomfortable with my silence.
I like to think that my lack of Evil Eye gave me the opportunity to train this part here.
I pointed at my head and attempted to lighten the mood.
Shikanosuke, who should have been the last one in the line, was no longer there.
Huh? That guy... I told him not wander off...
Did he run home because he was scared?
Maybe he got lost while going to the bathroom...
Oh, damn it... nothing we can do about it.
Gotta go and find him, right, Fuma-chan?
Ehh!? Shikanosuke-chan might be so scared he'll die!!
He's not gonna die from something like that. He's got a good sense of direction, he'll be fine.
I wasn't sure if it had anything to do with his Electric Art,
but Shikanosuke was the type who always found his way while saying something like "I guess it's this way."
He might get eaten by animals...
Speaking of animals, there are Shinobi Bears and Shinobi Snakes as guards around here, but there's no way they'll attack Taimanin, right, Sakura-sensei?
Animals had been utilized since ancient times, but even today Taimanin were finding animals with abilities, training them, and using them to defend their bases.
And the one taking care of these "Animal Taimanin" was Sakura-sensei.
I-It'll be fine! They're super friendly when I'm around!
